title: Accred Badges
tagline: Decentralized Application to Draft, Design and Issue Certificates, Badges and any type of Credential to Individuals as Non Fungible Tokens (NFTs) to your Recipients, Participants and Community
description:
We built a Decentralized Application to enable creators, events and organizations to Draft, Design and Issue Certificates, Badges and any type of Credential to Individuals as Non Fungible Tokens (NFTs).

With NFTs & we have the ability to issue Smart credential are full proof, decentralized and insured from fraud, combining them with the NFT implementation you are guaranteed of the highest level of authenticity
how_its_made: We built this to support EVM chains and leveraged Moralis to make development fast, Frontend is written in Typescript.  A list of technologies are Nextjs, React, Truffle, Openzeppelin. We built a design editor that is easy to use for credentials so that the UX for issuing badges would be seamless.
